items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I don't know what Charlie Irvis, I don't know what Charlie Irvis did any, maybe there.

ctx.x: Well, he stayed, he was on it, he was on it before me, because it was Cy St. Clair that brought Ben Whitted in. And when I got sick Happy Cauldwell took my place on some of them. See, so that was the names that you must have. You don't have those names - if you don't have Cy St. Clair, then I wasn't on it at all. Or something wrong with the, you know. See, 'cause that's who recommend me, you know. Say, I didn't make nothing without him bein' there because everybody was saying how great he was, he was a great bass…

He brought in Ben Whitted and he brought in me, see? But he didn't - I don't know what Charlie Irvis, I don't know what Charlie Irvis did any, maybe there. Because I think we had Cuffey, I remember Cuffey real well. Another guy that was there often that you must check on, the cousin of Joe Oliver, and he did the arrangement -
